question: In which of the following Indian states will you find the Buxa Fort?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Buxa Fort **is located in the Buxa Tiger Reserve, in the **Kalchini CD block of the Alipurduar subdivision **of the Alipurduar district, **West Bengal,** at an elevation of 867 metres (2,844 feet).
 
• **Alipurduar, **the nearest town, is 30 kilometres (19 miles) away.
 
• The fort was utilised by the Bhutanese King to secure the section of the border between Tibet and India that passed through Bhutan.
 
• Hundreds of refugees arrived at the location afterwards, during the upheaval in Tibet's occupation, and used the abandoned fort as a haven.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Buxa Tiger Reserve **is a tiger reserve and national park in northern West Bengal, India, that spans 760 square kilometres.
 
• It varies in altitude from 60 metres in the Gangetic Plains to 1,750 metres on the Himalayan border in the north.
 
• The reserve is home to at least 284 different bird species.
